CustomObject.description: Config object: the sellable gala levels (individual ticket, table, sponsorship tiers, etc.). Each level sets its price, seats/tables included, the non-deductible (fair-market) value, and benefits — so recording a gala purchase is just picking a level. Admin-maintained; client provides the exact list. Gala Event Gifts. Author: Jason Ott.
CustomObject.label: Gala Level
